parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a toilet, typically made of durable plastic. It covers the toilet bowl when not in use.
parts.Functional_description: The lid serves to cover the toilet bowl, reduce odor, and provide a clean appearance. It can be lifted or closed as needed.
parts.Movement_description: It is hinged at the back and can rotate upward or downward around the hinge axis.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of a toilet, made of ceramic material. It supports the lid and contains the bowl and flushing system.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural support, houses the water and waste channels, and connects to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed component and does not move during normal operation.
